name: Subtract_TiltSer_Background
label: Background Subtraction (Manual)
description: Subtract the mean of a background region from each tilt image. Drag the box in the 3D view over an empty area; its X and Y extents set the region, and its Z extent the tilt images to correct.

parameters.name: XRANGE
parameters.label: X Range
parameters.description: Start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) voxel indices along X.

parameters.name: YRANGE
parameters.label: Y Range
parameters.description: Start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) voxel indices along Y.

parameters.name: ZRANGE
parameters.label: Z Range
parameters.description: Start (inclusive) and end (exclusive) indices of the tilt images to correct.
